subject: Invoice bucketization, PO-id entropy and netterm banding
messages:
From: Alison Park <alison.park@brightpath.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpath.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice approach for multi-PO engagement (bucketization question)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has a few specific constraints we need to confirm before we can route the SOW to legal:

- We operate with high PO entropy across multiple business units (each PO has its own internal cost center). Can you support invoice bucketization so each invoice maps to a single PO ID?
- If we receive one consolidated invoice, AP will reject it unless the invoice includes per-line PO references and a per-PO subtotal. Is it possible to provide that?
- Net terms: our standard is net45 but we can consider net30 for an initial onboarding invoice. Any flexibility from Redwood on net terms and invoice cadence?
- Also confirm whether we can get an invoice per month vs. quarterly for the pilot.

I attached an example PO (PO_SAMPLE_78912.pdf) to show the format our ERP expects. Please share an approach and any impact on pricing/discounting if we require per-PO invoicing.

Would like to close procurement within two weeks.

Best,
Alison Park
Director, Procurement
Brightpath Health

Attachments: PO_SAMPLE_78912.pdf (PDF, 248 KB)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@brightpath.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice approach for multi-PO engagement (bucketization question)

Hi Alison —

Thanks for the clear example and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can support per-PO line item mapping and per-PO subtotals, but it affects our billing template and some automation on our side. High-level options:

1) Per-PO invoices: we emit separate invoices per PO ID on each billing cycle (monthly or quarterly). Clean for your AP, slightly higher processing overhead on our billing side.
2) Consolidated invoice with per-line PO mapping: single invoice that includes a line-by-line PO reference + per-PO subtotal section. Lower overhead for both parties but some ERPs still flag consolidated invoices.
3) Hybrid: monthly invoices, but we can group by business unit and include separate attachment CSV that your ERP can consume for automatic posting.

Pricing/discount impact: our standard tiered discounts are tied to invoiced ARR cadence. More frequent invoicing (monthly) increases our processing frequency but does not materially change list pricing. If you require per-PO invoice emission (option 1) at monthly frequency we would request a small operational fee to offset invoicing run costs for high-volume PO counts. Alternatively, we can offer a conditional discount ladder that phases in based on committed annual spend (see proposed structure below).

Proposed conditioning (quick draft):
- Onboarding month: single pro forma invoice (net30) to accelerate go-live; subsequent invoices net45 for remainder of quarter.
- If committed ARR >= $250k: 5% discount; >= $500k: 10% discount — discount applied at quarterly true-up.
- If per-PO separate invoices required every month: one-time invoicing setup fee (waived if committed ARR >= $500k).

I’m looping Marissa (Finance) and Karthik (Account lead) to confirm acceptance of netterm compromise and the logistics of emitting per-PO invoices. We can also do a 30-minute call to finalize.

Next steps: if you can confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and whether the AP system requires separate invoices vs. consolidated with PO mapping, we’ll put together a formal billing mapping doc and pricing appendix.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Invoice-Mapping-Proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 42 KB)

From: Alison Park <alison.park@brightpath.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpath.com
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice approach for multi-PO engagement (bucketization question)

Thanks Ben —

We reviewed the three options. Our preference is: monthly invoices, separate per-PO if possible. Internal AP will accept consolidated invoices only if each PO is a clearly separate subtotal header (they still prefer separate invoices).

On net terms: procurement will push for net45 but can accept net30 for onboarding if you confirm net45 afterward. Discount bands: procurement asked whether the discount can be applied to each invoice immediately (at point-of-billing) rather than at quarterly true-up. They dislike retroactive true-ups due to budget visibility.

Attaching the PO extract and our AP requirements.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can attach a machine-readable CSV for each invoice to support automated ERP ingestion?

Regards,
Alison

Attachments: PO_SAMPLE_78912.pdf (re-attached)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice approach for multi-PO engagement (internal pricing note)

FYI — forwarding Alison's asks. My thoughts:

- Technical feasibility: engineering/billing can emit per-PO invoices and include a per-invoice CSV attachment with PO mapping. We’ll need to add a per-invoice metadata field (PO_ID) to the invoice ID — low dev cost but needs QA.
- Netterm: we should accept onboarding net30, then net45 ongoing. That aligns collection risk with their ask while giving them visibility.
- Discount application: I recommend applying the discount at point-of-billing if the customer signs a commitment letter that defines committed ARR bands. We can then apply the discount immediately and reconcile if usage falls below the band at the quarterly true-up; if shortfall, we issue a small debit/chargeback. Procurement prefers no retroactive surprises — the commitment letter alleviates that.

Proposed commercial language for Ben to present:
"If Brightpath executes the attached commitment letter (minimum committed ARR of $250,000), Redwood will apply a 5% discount to invoices at the time of billing. A quarterly reconciliation will true-up consumption against the committed ARR; any shortfall may result in a retroactive correction limited to the difference in discount applied and earned."

Operational ask: one-time invoicing setup for per-PO monthly invoices (estimate 4–6 hours of engineering + QA). Suggest we waive the fee for $500k+ commitments.

Will draft the commitment letter and the billing appendix once Ben confirms they want a commitment band applied at billing.

-Marissa
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 120 KB) (internal copy)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@brightpath.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice approach for multi-PO engagement (agreement and next steps)

Alison —

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Proposed final approach below; please confirm and we’ll issue a commitment letter and the billing appendix for signature: 

1) Billing cadence & PO handling
- Redwood will emit monthly invoices.
- For each invoice we will either (a) emit a separate invoice per PO ID or (b) emit a consolidated invoice that includes a machine-readable CSV attachment with PO_ID, line_item_id, and per-PO subtotal — you choose which your ERP prefers.
2) Net terms
- Onboarding invoice (first month): net30 to accelerate go-live.
- Subsequent invoices: net45.
3) Discounts & commitment
- If Brightpath signs a 12-month commitment letter for committed ARR >= $250k, Redwood will apply a 5% discount at the time of billing. Discount will be visible on each invoice.
- Quarterly reconciliation will compare consumption to committed ARR; if actuals fall below commitment, a limited correction will be issued to reconcile discounts.
4) Operational/one-time setup
- There is a small one-time invoicing setup effort to enable per-PO monthly PDFs/CSV mapping. Redwood will waive this fee if committed ARR >= $500k.

Next steps: I’ll send the commitment letter and billing appendix (DocuSign link) once you confirm: (a) preferred invoice delivery format (separate invoices per PO vs consolidated + CSV), and (b) whether Brightpath is open to the 12-month commitment band.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that’s easier — Karthik can host the technical walkthrough.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood-Invoice-Mapping-Proposal.xlsx; SOW_v3.pdf
